title: Nine Weeks of Naming
subtitle: 克隆与复制 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 克隆与复制（科学与技术·生物技术与复制）
meta: 主题语境：克隆与复制（科学与技术·生物技术与复制）　|　核心词汇：clone　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 clone 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1996 my mother was sent to name ① clone she could not tell apart, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② clone, meaning the copy and not the original, was nine weeks old and was named by whoever came last; clone, she said, is the only thing in a laboratory that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ clone in that laboratory had the same mark, and the ④ clone at the end, meaning the one the team kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever named properly. Clone, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ clone was the whole of the argument, meaning the likeness it carried and not the copy. The ⑥ clone, meaning the likeness and not any of that, is the only thing in an argument that everybody fears and nobody questions; clone, he said, is either something you name or the only word that means both a copy and a likeness. She said the likeness is the part they remember.

By 2001 the ⑦ clone had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the mark. The ⑧ clone of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine weeks and eleven years of naming; clone, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ clone I remember is the one at the end, which was named in 2006 and is still described as the healthiest in the county. A ⑩ clone, my grandmother said in 2011, is the only thing that improves by being named; every clone, she said, is a likeness that has agreed to look like a copy. She said the likeness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 克隆（指那个复制体本身，与那个原体相对）
C. 固定搭配：name a clone 给一个克隆体命名
D. n. 克隆（指那间实验室里每一个）
E. n. 克隆（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 相似之物（抽象：它承载的那份相像）
G. n. 那份相像（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: clone she could not tell apart

answers.why: name a clone 意为“给一个克隆体命名”，1996 年母亲被派去给那个她分不清的克隆体命名。
clone 意为“克隆、复制品”，指那个复制体本身而不是那个原体，九周大，由最后来的人命名。
clone 指那间实验室里每一个克隆体，每一个都是同样的标记。
clone 指末尾那一个（研究组保留的那一个），是唯一有人认真命名过的。
clone 意为“相似之物”，抽象指它承载的那份相像，父亲说 clone 就是那场争论的全部。
clone 为抽象用法，指那份相像本身，是一场争论里人人都怕、却没人质疑的东西。
clone 意为“克隆、复制品”，到 2001 年这个 clone 成了报告里的一个数字。
clone 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九周和十一年的命名。
clone 意为“克隆体”，我记得的是末尾那一个，2006 年命名，至今仍被说成全县最健康的。
clone 为抽象总称，祖母说一个克隆体是唯一会因为被认真命名而变好的东西。
